criteria.text: The participant is aged 10 to 75 years (both inclusive).

criteria.text: The participant has a history of one of the following: treatment with dose-intensive chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy, previous history of allo/auto transplant, history of multiple myeloma or extramedullary plasmacytoma, or a chronic disease or co-morbid medical condition including symptoms or signs of significant pulmonary disease, hepatic disease, kidney disease, cardiac disease or disease of other organ systems which would result in increased risk of morbidity or death from a standard myeloablative transplant.

source.text:
with a history of one of the following:

* Treatment with dose intensive chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy
* Previous history of allo/auto transplant
* History of multiple myeloma or extramedullary plasmacytoma
* Chronic disease or co-morbid medical condition including subjects with symptoms or signs of significant pulmonary disease, hepatic disease, kidney disease, cardiac disease or disease of other organ systems which would result in increased risk of morbidity or death from a standard myeloablative transplant.

criteria.text: The participant has a history of one of the following: paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) associated with either life-threatening thrombosis, cytopenia, transfusion dependence or recurrent and debilitating hemolytic crisis; aplastic anemia or pure red cell aplasia (PRCA) (acquired or congenital) associated with transfusion dependence and/or neutropenia who are not candidates for or who have failed immunosuppressive therapy; or refractory anemia (RA) or refractory anemia with ringed sideroblasts (RARS) myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) subjects who have associated transfusion dependence and/or neutropenia.

source.text:
with a history of one of the following

* PNH associated with either life-threatening thrombosis, cytopenia, transfusion dependence or recurrent and debilitating hemolytic crisis.
* Aplastic anemia or PRCA (acquired or congenital) in subjects associated with transfusion dependence and/or neutropenia who are not candidates for or who have failed immunosuppressive therapy
* RA or RARS MDS subjects who have associated transfusion dependence and/or neutropenia.
